Prefix/suffix products. O(n) O(1) extra.

For product array except self I will sweep left-to-right then right-to-left.

```python
def product(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    out = [1] * n
    p = 1
    for i in range(n):
        out[i] = p; p *= nums[i]
    p = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        out[i] *= p; p *= nums[i]
    return out
```
